title: Ace Zaxy Super V3
features:
Script Description - AceZaxy Super V3

Here's the complete breakdown of what this script does:

What is it?

It's a Roblox script that creates a super cyberpunk loading screen + a full-featured interface (WindUI) with multiple features for manipulating parts, ESP, fly, and other functionalities.

Main Features:

🎨 Visual Interface (Loading Screen)

Ultra-stylized initial screen with cyberpunk theme (purple, cyan, neon)

Animated pulsing purple grid/grid animation

Floating neon particles

Retro CRT-style scanlines

Dark vignette on the edges

Progress bar with animation

Badge with random "fun facts"

🎮 Zaxy controller - Part Control

Controls up to 500 parts simultaneously

Different modes: Orbit, Knives, Cage, Float Wave, etc

Automatic Anti-Void (repositions parts that fall off the map)

Rainbow color pulsing system

👁️ ESP

Shows tracers (lines) of all players

Visualizes character skeletons

Shows names and distance

✈️ Fly/Movement

Flight system with smoothing

Smooth air control

Infinite SimulationRadius

🎵 Music System

Plays custom audio

Saves last track between sessions

Control via K button

💾 Auto-Save

Automatically saves settings to JSON

Restores settings on restart

🔐 Anti-Exploit

Locks stolen parts to the thief

⚙️ WindUI Interface

Main menu with multiple tabs (Ring, Wings, ESP, Fly, Settings, etc)

Customizable buttons with callbacks

Sliders for value adjustment

Toggle switches
